properties.method: Gaussian 16, PM7 (semiempirical), gas phase, SCF=tight, opt+freq
properties.zero_point_corrected: BDE D0(0 K) = 43.6 kcal/mol; dH(298.15 K) = 44.0 kcal/mol
properties.accuracy_note: PM7 reproduces the O-O length well (1.212 A) but over-binds the very long F-O bond (1.485 A vs about 1.575 A experimentally); the F-O BDE is therefore a semiempirical estimate, not a benchmark-quality number.
properties.gfn2_xtb_cross_check: F-O 1.518 A, O-O 1.211 A (GFN2-xTB geometry cross-check only; xtb total energies of isolated atoms are not reference-consistent, so no xtb BDE was used)
properties.pm7_validation: PM7 validation on F2 (calc/f2_val.log): D0(F-F) = 51.7 kcal/mol vs 37.0 kcal/mol experimental, i.e. PM7 over-binds F-X bonds by ~40%; the PM7 F-O BDE of 43.6 kcal/mol probably carries a similar positive bias (a corrected estimate would be ~30 kcal/mol). D0(F2) from the same PM7 atom energies was used as the internal consistency check of the atom reference.

properties.description: Products of homolytic F-O bond fission: free F atom (doublet) + FO radical (doublet)
Products of O-O homolysis; an additional characterized channel, not the requested quantity
properties.note: D0(0 K) = 58.7 kcal/mol, dH(298.15 K) = 59.7 kcal/mol from the same PM7 evidence

edges.channel: homolytic F-O fission, barrierless (barrier = BDE at 0 K)
